intent: An environment-variable editor for a deployment console: secrets stay masked until revealed, each key declares which environments hold it, a pasted .env flags duplicates and invalid keys instead of overwriting, and any edit raises a redeploy banner.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with @container queries; colours as CSS variables on the root (--ev-surface, --ev-well, --ev-raised, --ev-ink, --ev-muted, --ev-faint, --ev-line, --ev-warn, --ev-err, --ev-ok, --ev-accent)
stack.animation: motion/react: variants for the entrance, layoutId for the environment pill, layout for rows moving between groups, AnimatePresence for the import panel, banner and value swaps
stack.icons: drawn inline SVG (eye, paste, spinner); no icon package
stack.fonts: font-sans (Geist) for chips, banner and buttons; font-mono (Geist Mono) for keys, values, counts and the paste field

layout.root: section, @container, max-width 920px, 20px radius, overflow hidden, padding 20px and 24px from @xl
layout.header: accent dot and project name left; set-count and environment name right
layout.toolbar: environment radiogroup; Import .env full width below @2xl, beside the chips from @2xl
layout.import: well above the list: label, 3-row textarea, verdict lines, Discard and Add
layout.list: well, 14px radius; one column below @lg, three columns (13.5rem, value, scopes) from @lg; max-height 28rem with internal scroll from @lg
layout.row: key and meta, masked or plain value with a reveal control, Prod / Prev / Dev toggles at 44px below @lg and 32px from @lg
layout.banner: under the list once something changed: sentence plus a Redeploy button that keeps its width

color.accent: #7cc4ff by default; project dot, the word new, and the redeploy mark
color.secrets: muted while masked, ink when revealed or plain; never a title tooltip of the raw secret while masked

motion.entrance: header and toolbar rise 10px out of a 6px blur, 60ms apart, 560ms, cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)
motion.environment: pill travels with layoutId on spring stiffness 500, damping 40
motion.rows: same spring when a key moves between set-here and not-in-this-environment
motion.import: height and opacity over 320ms, exit 180ms ease-in
motion.values: cross-fade with a 4px rise and a 2px blur over 200ms
motion.banner: 8px rise and a 3px blur; set-count eases over 420ms
motion.redeploy: spinner for 880ms inside the same button, then Deployed
motion.reducedMotion: opacity only, 150ms or less; no blur, rise or count
motion.numericUpdates: Interpolate upward and downward from the current displayed value; resume interrupted transitions and clear number blur with reduced motion.

responsive.container: short environment labels and 44px controls below @lg; full names from @lg; import beside the chips and 32px chips from @2xl; list scrolls inside 28rem from @lg
responsive.rows: stacked key, value and equal-width scopes below @lg; one grid row from @lg
responsive.overflow: keys truncate; long values wrap after :// or @ so a masked host stays whole; nothing scrolls the page sideways

accessibility: Environment control is a radiogroup of radios
Scope buttons expose aria-pressed and a name that includes the variable
Reveal is a toggle named Reveal KEY or Hide KEY
Import field has a visible label; verdicts and the banner are aria-live polite
Escape closes import; Command-Enter or Control-Enter applies it
Keyboard-only 2px ink focus rings; 44px targets below @lg

content.variables: DATABASE_URL, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, RESEND_API_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL, LOG_LEVEL, SENTRY_DSN
content.gap: SENTRY_DSN is not set in production, so it sits under Not in production
content.import: BAD KEY=1 is invalid; a repeated STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is a duplicate and is not written

avoid: leaking a masked secret through a title tooltip
overwriting an existing key on import
a hue per environment or a tinted row
flagging the line that is still being typed
